briefdescription.para: Compute the instruction latency based on the available machine model.

detaileddescription.para: Compute and return the expected latency of this instruction independent of a particular use. computeOperandLatency is the preferred API, but this is occasionally useful to help estimate instruction cost.

If UseDefaultDefLatency is false and no new machine sched model is present this method falls back to TII->getInstrLatency with an empty instruction itinerary (this is so we preserve the previous behavior of the if converter after moving it to TargetSchedModel).
